notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS company building an in-product assistant + search layer. Primary constraint: predictable unit economics and SLOs for customer-facing chat. Evaluation path: hosted API POC -> Dedicated alpha -> procurement.

POC findings (hosted):
- Observed cost spike on long-chat sessions with repeated system prompts; caching plus deterministic prompt pre-tokenization reduced observed token units by ~18% in internal tests.
- Latency mostly within target for p50/p90; p95 spikes correlated with cold KV cache misses and model fallback to larger variant.
- Embedding runs acceptable but cost-sensitive for daily batch re-index (estimated 1.2M embeddings/month).

Cost-optimization workshop notes (02/12):
- Batching: we recommended adaptive batching window (up to 12ms) for bursty interactive traffic; projected 7-12% token-cost reduction at current traffic pattern.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for prompt + few-shot examples reduced repeated context by 18%-25% depending on user flow; suggested LRU TTL tuning per product area.

Direct customer comments:
- "We need predictable per-user cost forecasts — spikes hurt our freemium conversion math." (Head of Product)
- SE feedback: "Happy with runtime performance in demo; biggest wins will be caching + quantization for cost."
notes_continued:
- Quantization profiles: SE demoed 4-bit quant candidate for non-critical reranking models; showed 1.3x throughput and ~30% cost reduction with <1% quality regression on rerank metric (MRR). Suggested conservative rollout: rerank -> embeddings -> chat.
- Unit economics: built simple model in workshop (sheet linked) showing break-even between hosted vs dedicated at ~45M tokens/month for their most used model variants. Dedicated makes sense if committed throughput >= 500k tokens/day.

Quotes & pricing convo:
- Initial published estimate (hosted) showed $0.018/token effective at current mix; after batching/caching suggestions expected $0.014/token.
- Dedicated monthly proposal under review (see drive deck). They asked for a 6-month pilot pricing with a 30% commit uplift clause.

Security/Compliance:
- Strong requirement for SSO/SAML, KMS integration, and audit logs retained 13 months. Data residency: prefer US-only for PII workflows; EU for EU customers.

- Deliver revised Dedicated pilot pricing (AE + Pricing) by 2026-03-10.
